h1: AIVideosUGC FAQ: Answers Before You Start

secondary_keywords: credits and refunds for AI content

faq.q: What video lengths and frame sizes can I choose?
faq.a: Pick 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, then pick a frame: 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Product photos are square by default. The cost is shown before the job starts.
You see the credit cost before you start. Credits are held when the job starts and used when the file is delivered. If the job fails, the credits come back.

faq.q: Who can see my uploads and results?
faq.a: Other customers cannot see them. The photos you upload and the files you make stay in your account and are not published. If you email support about a job, we can look up that job.

faq.q: How do I add prices when using AI images in ads?
faq.a: Add prices, codes, and headlines after download, in Canva, CapCut, Ads Manager, or a similar tool. Typed text stays accurate. Captions and music go on the same way. The [AI ad image generator](page:social-ad-photos) makes the picture. The offer text stays yours.

faq.q: Can I use the images and videos commercially?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the images and videos you make in your own ads, product pages, and social posts.

faq.q: Do downloaded images and videos have a watermark?
faq.a: No. Downloaded images and videos do not include an AIVideosUGC watermark.

faq.q: Can I get a refund if I have not used the credits I bought?
faq.a: You can request a refund for purchased credits within 30 days if none of those credits have been used. See the [Refund Policy](/refunds). A failed job is separate: its credits return automatically.

faq.q: How many credits does a product photo or a video use?
faq.a: A product photo costs 24 credits. Use a clear, in-focus photo of the real item. Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. The exact cost appears before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.
